name: xhs-crafter v7.1.1
body:
## v7.1.1 Changes

### Changed
- Embedded font size cheat sheet (15-level type scale) directly in SKILL.md Step 3 Compose for cross-session consistency
- Fixed title consistency rule: h-xl 96px to 110px in SKILL.md iron rules section
- Updated README.md: version badge 7.1.1, 11 categories, validate.js and background-systems.md in file structure
- Added .claude-plugin/plugin.json for Claude Code metadata

## v7.1.0 Changes

### Added
- Background systems reference (paper-wash-grain three-layer architecture, atmosphere intensity levels)
- validate.js automated validation script (7 rules)
- Image source triage gate in Step 1 Intake
- Font weight iron rule and title consistency rule
- Hero title color rule: cover/finale must use #ffffff + text-shadow
- Screenshot size anomaly detection

### Changed
- Type scale increased ~15% for mobile readability (h-xl: 96 to 110px, body: 28 to 32px)
- Cover/finale titles use .h-display (136px) vs content pages .h-xl (110px)
- Category cookbook expanded from 7 to 11 categories
- Theme presets: added hard rules (no custom hex, Lemon Green max 20%)
